evals.prompt: Turn on the kitchen and living room lights to 75% brightness
evals.expected_output: Both rooms turn on with 75% brightness, command returns success status

assertions.name: uses_batch_syntax
assertions.description: Command uses room batch syntax (multiple room names in single openhue command)

assertions.name: sets_brightness_75
assertions.description: Brightness is set to 75%

assertions.name: turns_on_both_rooms
assertions.description: Kitchen and Living room lights are turned on

assertions.name: succeeds_without_error
assertions.description: Command completes successfully without error messages

evals.prompt: Set the eatery to a warm color at 40% brightness with a 2 second transition
evals.expected_output: Eatery lights adjust to warm temperature, 40% brightness, with smooth 2-second transition

assertions.name: sets_warm_temperature
assertions.description: Uses warm color temperature (high mirek value, 350+)

assertions.name: sets_brightness_40
assertions.description: Brightness is set to 40%

assertions.name: uses_transition_time
assertions.description: Includes --transition-time 2s parameter

assertions.name: targets_eatery
assertions.description: Targets the Eatery room specifically

evals.prompt: Check what lights are currently on, then turn off only the kitchen ones
evals.expected_output: Lists current state of all lights, then turns off kitchen lights only

assertions.name: queries_state_first
assertions.description: Uses openhue get lights or openhue get rooms to check state

assertions.name: turns_off_kitchen_only
assertions.description: Uses kitchen-specific lights/room name in turn-off command

assertions.name: selective_control
assertions.description: Does not turn off lights outside the kitchen

assertions.name: shows_both_steps
assertions.description: Output shows both query and control commands

evals.prompt: I want to control the three kitchen spots - set spot 1 to 30%, spot 2 to 60%, and spot 3 to 90%
evals.expected_output: Each kitchen spot set to its specified brightness level individually

assertions.name: three_separate_commands
assertions.description: Uses three individual commands for the three spots

assertions.name: spot1_at_30
assertions.description: Kitchen 1 (or Spot 1) set to 30% brightness

assertions.name: spot2_at_60
assertions.description: Kitchen 2 (or Spot 2) set to 60% brightness

assertions.name: spot3_at_90
assertions.description: Kitchen 3 (or Spot 3) set to 90% brightness

evals.prompt: Turn off the driveway, garden, and office lights
evals.expected_output: All three rooms turn off, command returns success

assertions.name: uses_batch_syntax
assertions.description: Uses batch syntax with multiple rooms in single command if possible

assertions.name: turns_off_driveway
assertions.description: Driveway lights are turned off

assertions.name: turns_off_garden
assertions.description: Garden lights are turned off

assertions.name: turns_off_office
assertions.description: Office lights are turned off
